figma.text:
When the company announces a strict ban on office romance, a dedicated employee realizes her growing feelings for her direct manager could put both of their careers at risk. After a late-night elevator incident brings them unexpectedly close, they begin dating in secret, hiding their relationship behind professional distance, coded messages, and discreet meetings outside the office. As rumors spread and they are nearly caught together, her manager becomes colder in public to protect them, creating tension and doubt between them. Their worst fear comes true when HR launches an investigation following an anonymous report, forcing them to choose between their careers and their relationship. In the end, he decides to reveal the truth and request a transfer, accepting the professional consequences so they can finally be together without hiding.

Possible Characters:
Sophie: A careful and detailed office worker who is deeply in love with her manager, constantly trying to balance her career with her secret passion.
The Manager: A disciplined, restrained leader who lets his guard down only when alone with Sophie, desperately trying to protect her and their career.
HR Officer: A vigilant HR representative who strictly enforces the company's no-dating policy and watches employees closely.
Coworker: An overly curious colleague who frequently wanders the halls and almost catches Sophie and the Manager in their private moments.

Claire reluctantly agrees to Liam's ridiculous rules, cementing their counterfeit relationship with a strict handshake.

【An Unannounced Arrival】
Before they can rehearse their backstory, Claire's suspicious colleague knocks loudly on her door demanding to meet the new boyfriend.

Possible Characters:

After a late-night elevator incident brings them unexpectedly close, they begin dating in secret, hiding their relationship behind professional distance, coded messages, and discreet meetings outside the office. As rumors spread and they are nearly caught together, her manager becomes colder in public to protect them, creating tension and doubt between them. Their worst fear comes true when HR launches an investigation following an anonymous report, forcing them to choose between their careers and their relationship. In the end, he decides to reveal the truth and request a transfer, accepting the professional consequences so they can finally be together without hiding.

Possible Characters:
Sophie: A careful and detailed office worker who is deeply in love with her manager, constantly trying to balance her career with her secret passion.
The Manager: A disciplined, restrained leader who lets his guard down only when alone with Sophie, desperately trying to protect her and their career.
HR Officer: A vigilant HR representative who strictly enforces the company's no-dating policy and watches employees closely.
Coworker: An overly curious colleague who frequently wanders the halls and almost catches Sophie and the Manager in their private moments.

Lauren realizes Julian genuinely wants to support artists, and their shared purpose creates their first flirtatious moment.

Julian remembers Lauren’s coffee order and reveals that the foundation was the dream of his late mother, a public-school art teacher.

While adjusting a painting’s position, Julian and Lauren move increasingly close and can no longer ignore their attraction.

【More Than the Foundation】
Julian admits that he wants more time with Lauren and promises to ask her out after the opening.

After dedicating the foundation to his mother and publicly thanking Lauren, Julian asks her on a date, and she accepts.
